endorsements.name: Nanzi Yang
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-9779
endorsements.description: A flaw was found in Open Cluster Management (OCM) when a user has access to the worker nodes which contain the cluster-manager or klusterlet deployments. The cluster-manager deployment uses a service account with the same name "cluster-manager" which is bound to a ClusterRole also named "cluster-manager", which includes the permission to create Pod resources. If this deployment runs a pod on an attacker-controlled node, the attacker can obtain the cluster-manager's token and steal any service account token by creating and mounting the target service account to control the whole cluster.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.5)
